liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Eyes of the World** (2 reviews): The Eyes of the World into Dark Star into Fire on the Mountain sequence rocked; Eyes of the World was a definite highlight of the show for this listener [5][11]

## Setlist highlights

- **Big RxR Blues**: rare: 5 archived performances [13]
- **Dark Star v.1**: rare: 12 archived performances [13]
- **Johnny B. Goode**: back after 50 archived shows (632 days); rare: 13 archived performances [13]
- **Mickey**: rare: 9 archived performances [13]

## The recordings

- **dac2023-06-07.AKGmix.toaste.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 19 songs; 185 min; rated 4.25/5 by 8 [1]. Said about its sound: Bass in the mix is abundant, far more than in any earlier Dead & Company recording the listener has heard; Front-of-board tapes tend to sound worse than recordings made from the lawn sweet spot; Oteil is higher in the mix than the listener has ever heard [7][9][12]
- **deadco2023-06-07.SchoepsMK21-MixPre6ii_Flac24**: source not stated; 18 songs; 186 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [2]

## Around the show

- For this listener it was their first ever Dead show [6]
- The venue, called Riverport here, has a lawn sound system that has always been well maintained, and the taper recorded solo [9]
- Listener thinks this may be the best of the 11 shows on the 'last tour' so far [4]
- Listener wasn't blown away by the setlist at this show, though it had some gems [11]
- Listener has seen one or two Dead & Company shows yearly since the band began and ranks this the best [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **dac2023-06-07.AKGmix.toaste.flac16**: taped by Toaste; transferred by Toaste; source: DFC Lawn > 3x AKG d222e cardioids (L,C,R); 1x AKG394 figure-8 (L,R); 2x AKG392 omnis 2-foot spread (L,R); 2x AKG398 shotguns pointed at stacks (L,R) > Zoom F8… [1]. Also: Taper Toaste's upload was still unfinished on the afternoon of June 10, 2023, so the show couldn't be downloaded yet [4]
- **deadco2023-06-07.SchoepsMK21-MixPre6ii_Flac24**: taped by Steve Brothers; transferred by Steve Brothers; source: Schoeps MK21 subcards (NOS) > NBob KCY Cables > Sound Devices MixPre6ii. DFC on the lawn just behind reserved lawn section. (Also ran DPA 4021 on the same… [2]
